why: Drops the controlling-player filter, the presence-only mistake CLAUDE.md names on a shared event stream: `fire-blocked` is emitted for whoever was refused, AI tanks and other players included, so the local HUD would announce an enemy's capacity as though it were the player's own. #356 requires the cue to appear only for the controlling player and only for the capacity condition; this breaks the first half while leaving every single-tank test green.
killedBy: blocked-fire HUD cue (issue #516, parent #356) ignores a refusal that is not the CONTROLLING player's
